epics.title: EPIC: Gate and fingerprint integrity
epics.body_intro: The gate must be able to fail, and its verdict must describe the tree it was recorded against. Two instances of the self-invalidating class were fixed on 2026-07-30; the rest of this epic is what is still unproven.
tasks: DONE 2026-07-30: HARNESS_OUTPUTS excludes state/prompt-tickets.jsonl and state/skill-use.jsonl from the tree fingerprint. Four fingerprints across four turns of one session (76378e5f, 05fdfc73, b10cfce6, 9f0ccd38) each had a green run rejected at the Stop boundary. Two mutants, 12 tests, round-trip verified identical before and after a run
Wire tools/docmap into the gate docs domain. It exists, checks clean on 929 documents, and nothing enforces it on future commits
Mutation control proving the docmap selftest can go red, so it meets the repo's own four-layer standard

Print the joint claim under gate.py run VERDICT: which domains were N/A, why, and what a PASS does not assert (RT-3)
